name: HobbyZone AeroScout S 2 1.1m
summary: Foam beginner trainer, 1.1 m: high wing, pusher prop, tricycle gear with nose-wheel steering. 2306 2250Kv, 3S 2200 mAh, ~850 g. Starts in SAFE.

notes.units: Units: metres, kilograms, newtons, seconds; angles in degrees where the name ends in 'Deg'. 'tuning' holds built-in changes in the Tuning tab's terms (paste an Export's "tuning" here).
notes.about: For club beginners. Published: span about 1095 mm (retailers; the manual's spec table says 1033 mm), length about 870 mm, 2306 2250Kv motor, 3S 1300-2200 mAh, CG 60-75 mm behind the leading edge at the root (75 mm suggested), low rates 70% of high, flies level at 50-60% throttle. Estimated: planform and wing area (~0.2 m²), the prop (6x4), thrust, inertia, airfoil and drag, weight with a 2200 pack.
notes.look: Drawn from the dimensions and the general layout, not traced from any drawing. Plain club colours, no maker's markings: change 'colors' to your club's.
notes.defaultAssist: SAFE (Beginner mode: limited bank and pitch, self-levelling). G cycles off / AS3X / SAFE.
notes.throws: High rates; use the transmitter's 70% low rate for first flights.
notes.trim: tailIncidenceDeg and the thrust figures are set so it flies level at about 55% throttle (~11 m/s) and climbs gently at full power, as the manual describes.
notes.prop: 6x4 assumed on the 2306 2250Kv / 3S: loaded rpm, static thrust (N) and full-throttle current (A) are estimates.
